About

Fusion Updates (fusionupdates.com) turns Oracle's quarterly readiness documentation into a filterable, plain-English list of changes across Oracle Fusion Cloud, with draft impact ratings and a what-to-test checklist for every update.

It is run by an Oracle supply chain and ERP consultant based in Switzerland (PrimeLogic Advisory). Every entry links back to its Oracle source page. Summaries are condensed from Oracle's text, and impact ratings are editorial judgment, so always check the Oracle page and your own configuration.

This is an independent site, not affiliated with or endorsed by Oracle.

Method: features come from the "Feature Summary" tables in Oracle's What's New documents. Enablement comes from Oracle's "Action to Enable" column plus the Current Opt-In Expirations list. Impact draft: Oracle's "Larger scale" maps to high; opt-ins expiring this update or next are high; "Small scale" or automatically enabled Redwood changes are medium; everything else is low.

Independent site, not affiliated with or endorsed by Oracle. Oracle and Oracle Fusion are trademarks of Oracle and/or its affiliates. Summaries are condensed from Oracle's public readiness documentation; always confirm details on the linked Oracle page. Impact ratings are editorial drafts.
